status: NORMATIVE_DRAFT — binding for every program-owned repository from R00 (DEC-AUP-0008); this JSON is what tools/graph/schema_check.py, build_graph.py and impact.py import; the .md explains it and the JSON wins where they disagree
purpose: A relationship graph is a measurement instrument, not a source of truth: it SELECTS what a change must re-verify. It is only a production artefact when it can state which commit it represents, when and by what it was built, which edges are inferred, and what every node's content hash was.

code_unit.granularity: file (class-level nodes only at contract/route boundaries)
code_unit.content_hash: sha256 of the file bytes at source_commit

contract.content_hash: sha256 of the declaring file bytes (GRAPH-004 narrows it to the declaration text)

route.content_hash: sha256 of the providing file bytes

data_model.granularity: one Prisma model or enum (or table)
data_model.content_hash: sha256 of the model block text

deployable_unit.granularity: service / CLI / front-end / adapter / shared package
deployable_unit.content_hash: sha256 of its package manifest bytes

document.granularity: one KB/Scrutator document or repo markdown file

work_item.content_hash: sha256 of the id (revision hash once Muneral supplies it)

imports.meaning: static import/export/require of another unit (resolved) or a reuse: @arcanada/* marker

calls.meaning: runtime invocation; deterministic when resolvable from the AST, inferred for DI wiring / config-driven instantiation / dynamic dispatch
calls.mandatory_verifier_hint: type-check of the caller; canary when inferred across a boundary

implements_contract.meaning: the unit declares or serves the contract (provider side)

consumes_contract.meaning: the unit depends on the contract (consumer side); target route = an HTTP client call site bound to a served route

maps_model.meaning: code uses a data model (client call / generated type) or a model relates to another model

documents.meaning: a document or work item describes the target (deterministic only through an explicit link/id; otherwise inferred)

verifies.meaning: a receipt or a test unit verifies the target
verifies.mandatory_verifier_hint: selectable: run the targeted test / re-read the receipt

deploys_to.meaning: the unit ships inside / is deployed as the deployable

provenance.deterministic: extracted by a deterministic parser from committed sources; reproducible byte-for-byte from the same commit
provenance.inferred: derived by a heuristic, DI/config-wiring analysis, URL matching or an LLM; REQUIRES `inferred_by`; a candidate edge, never alone sufficient to waive a contract check across a service boundary
provenance.observed: seen at runtime (trace / canary); REQUIRES `observed_at_utc`; never ground truth, carries the time it was seen
provenance.rule: every edge carries exactly one provenance value; an edge without it is a schema violation, not a warning

forbidden.inferred_by on a deterministic edge: LLM_EDGE_NOT_INFERRED — an edge that names an inference method is inferred by definition

manifest.graph_digest: sha256 over canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) of {nodes, edges, manifest minus graph_digest minus built_at_utc}; two builds of one commit must share the digest and, with an equal built_at_utc, be byte-identical
manifest.dirty_rule: a graph built on a dirty working tree carries dirty=true and is refused by impact/admission (STALE_GRAPH)

document_layout.edges: array sorted by (from, type, to, provenance)

rules.MANIFEST_MISSING_FIELD: a required manifest field is absent
rules.BUILT_AT_INVALID: manifest.built_at_utc is not an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp
rules.NODE_WITHOUT_HASH: node lacks content_hash in the form sha256:<64 hex>
rules.NODE_ID_FORM: node id does not start with '<type>:'
rules.LLM_EDGE_NOT_INFERRED: an edge carries inferred_by (or via: llm) but claims provenance deterministic/observed
rules.EDGE_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN: edge.from or edge.to names no node in the graph
rules.EDGE_ENDPOINT_TYPE_MISMATCH: edge endpoints violate the edge type's allowed from/to node types
rules.GRAPH_DIGEST_MISMATCH: manifest.graph_digest does not equal the recomputed digest
rules.GRAPH_DIRTY: manifest.dirty = true (informational for the validator; a refusal for impact/admission)

verdicts.violation: ≥ 1 violation code; the classification is deterministic and blind-reproducible
